cohort_total_n_excerpt: We analyzed data from a population-based prospective cohort study including 2,003 initially cancer-free participants from the KORA F4 study with baseline serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D (25(OH)D) measurements (surveyed between 2006 and 2008).
reason: The initially cancer-free cohort was analyzed for incident cancer, including a prostate cancer subgroup, but the abstract does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, or lethal prostate cancer endpoint. The 69 reported cases are for all cancers and cannot be assigned to prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: This was also true in subgroup analysis for prostate cancer (HR 0.95, 95% CI 0.88-1.03), breast cancer (HR 1.03, 95% CI 0.97-1.09), and colorectal cancer (HR 0.97, 95% CI 0.88-1.07).
estimate_classifications.reason: This is an overall incident prostate cancer subgroup estimate, with no aggressive-disease restriction.
